pairs.target: yīwén méiyǒu shàngdàng .
pairs.english: Iven wasn't fooled.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没有上当。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn shī zhǐdài , xiān wén le wén , wèn tǎ wéi shìbushì dǎsuàn ná zhège zhèngmíng zìjǐ píngān huílái le .
pairs.english: Seeing the wet wrapper, he sniffed first and asked Tavi whether he meant to use this as proof he'd returned safely.
pairs.hanzi: 他看见湿纸袋，先闻了闻，问塔维是不是打算拿这个证明自己平安回来了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō lùshang mǎi de , yīwén biàn bǎ guǒzi tuī dào mǐlā miànqián .
pairs.english: Tavi said he'd bought it on the way, so Iven pushed the fruit in front of Mira.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说路上买的，伊文便把果子推到米拉面前。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhǐ kàn yìyǎn , jiù jiào liǎnggè rén xiān qù xǐshǒu , biépèng tā de shū .
pairs.english: Mira took only one look, then told both of them to wash their hands first and not touch her books.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉只看一眼，就叫两个人先去洗手，别碰她的书。

pairs.target: děng tǎ wéi huílái , guǒzi yǐjīng fàngzài kōng dié lǐ , pángbiān duō le yìxiǎocuō yán .
pairs.english: When Tavi returned, the fruit was already on an empty plate, with a pinch of salt beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 等塔维回来，果子已经放在空碟里，旁边多了一小撮盐。

pairs.target: yīwén zhàn yán yǎoleyìkǒu , miànbùgǎisè , dàobǎ tǎ wéi kàn lèng le .
pairs.english: Iven dipped it in salt and took a bite without changing expression, which instead left Tavi staring.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文蘸盐咬了一口，面不改色，倒把塔维看愣了。

pairs.target: " nǐ yǐwéi zhǐyǒu nǐ huì chīkǔ ? "
pairs.english: “You think only you can take hardship?”
pairs.hanzi: “你以为只有你会吃苦？”

pairs.target: mǐlā zhōngyú xiào le , shēnshǒu bāi zǒu méi bèi yǎo guò de yìxiǎokuài .
pairs.english: Mira finally laughed and reached to break off a little piece that hadn't been bitten.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉终于笑了，伸手掰走没被咬过的一小块。

pairs.target: sāngè rén bǎ nà kē guǒzi fēn wán , tǎ wéi cái náchū cǎogǎo , xiān shuō yú shīfu zhǔn tā liúxià , búshì bǎ rénjiā de jìlù tōudài huílái .
pairs.english: Only after the three shared that fruit did Tavi take out the draft, first explaining Master Yu had let him keep it, rather than stealing the records of somebody else.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人把那颗果子分完，塔维才拿出草稿，先说虞师傅准他留下，不是把人家的记录偷带回来。

pairs.target: yīwén fān dào wāi tǒng nà miàn , wèn zhèwèi cháng tuǐ shīfu shìbushì yě lǐng le bànrì gōng .
pairs.english: Iven turned to the side with the crooked bucket and asked whether this long-legged craftworker had earned a half-day credit too.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文翻到歪桶那面，问这位长腿师傅是不是也领了半日工。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō nà shì nài lěi huà de , mǐlā biàn bǎ zhǐ nuó jìn , rènzhēn kàn le liǎngtiáo bù yíyàng cháng de tuǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi said Nerai had drawn it, so Mira moved the paper closer and carefully examined the two unequal legs.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说那是奈蕾画的，米拉便把纸挪近，认真看了两条不一样长的腿。

pairs.target: " tā tǐng liǎojiě nǐ . "
pairs.english: “She knows you rather well.”
pairs.hanzi: “她挺了解你。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zhǐ fān huíqù , gěi tāmen jiǎng huànbǎn de jīngguò .
pairs.english: Tavi turned the paper back and told the story of replacing the board to them.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把纸翻回去，给他们讲换板的经过。

pairs.target: jiǎng dào nǚrén gēn děng chuán de rén chǎojià , yīwén méi jiē xiàohuà , zhǐzhe shàngxià liǎngdào hóngxiàn wèn chà le duōshǎo .
pairs.english: When he described the woman arguing with the man waiting for a boat, Iven didn't joke, but pointed to the two red lines above and below and asked how much they differed.
pairs.hanzi: 讲到女人跟等船的人吵架，伊文没接笑话，指着上下两道红线问差了多少。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ méi liáng , huà shàng yě búshì zhào chǐcùn suōxiàlái de , bùnéng ná shǒuzhǐ yì bǐ jiùsuàn .
pairs.english: Tavi said he hadn't measured it, and the drawing wasn't scaled to dimensions, so comparing with fingers couldn't give a result.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己没量，画上也不是照尺寸缩下来的，不能拿手指一比就算。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ shēnchū de liǎng zhǐ shōuhuí qù , shuō zìjǐ hái méi nàme lìhài .
pairs.english: Iven withdrew the two fingers he'd stretched out, saying he wasn't that accomplished yet.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把伸出的两指收回去，说自己还没那么厉害。

pairs.target: tā wèn le yè chuán , tīng wán yú shīfu hé nài lěi gèzì dehuà , méiyǒu shuō zhàng yǐjīng jiěshì tōng le .
pairs.english: He asked about night boats, heard Master Yu's and Nerai's separate accounts, and didn't say the ledger had now been explained.
pairs.hanzi: 他问了夜船，听完虞师傅和奈蕾各自的话，没有说账已经解释通了。

pairs.target: " děi xiān zhīdào shì nǎtiáo chuán . "
pairs.english: “First we need to know which boat it is.”
pairs.hanzi: “得先知道是哪条船。”

pairs.target: tā shuō bǎ nà jù jìxiàlái , yòu wèn néng bunéng chāo nàduàn guānyú zhá de huídá .
pairs.english: He said he'd note that down, then asked whether he could copy the answer about the sluice.
pairs.hanzi: 他说把那句记下来，又问能不能抄那段关于闸的回答。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dāying , jiào tā xiě qīng zhè shì yú shīfu shuō de , bìng búshì zìjǐ zài yèlǐ zǒuguò .
pairs.english: Tavi agreed, telling him to make clear that Master Yu had said this, not that he'd travelled at night himself.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应，叫他写清这是虞师傅说的，并不是自己在夜里走过。

pairs.target: mǐlā què yìzhí dīng zhe zhǐbiān yìfú hěncū de jiāzi tú .
pairs.english: Mira, meanwhile, kept staring at a very rough clamp sketch on the edge of the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉却一直盯着纸边一幅很粗的夹子图。

alignment.english: on the edge of the paper

pairs.target: nà shì tǎ wéi huílái hòu píng jìyì tiān de , liǎnggè mùbǐng huà de jīhū yíyàng , luógǎn què suō zài jiǎoluò .
pairs.english: Tavi had added it from memory after returning; the two wooden handles were drawn almost identically, but the screw shrank into a corner.
pairs.hanzi: 那是塔维回来后凭记忆添的，两个木柄画得几乎一样，螺杆却缩在角落。

pairs.target: tā wèn jiāohuàn tíng le yǐhòu , mùbǐng hái dòngbudòng .
pairs.english: She asked whether the handles still moved after the exchange stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 她问交换停了以后，木柄还动不动。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō méiyǒu , tā kànzhe yú shīfu quèrèn liǎngbiān huīfù , jiāzi réngjiù kòu zhe diànmù .
pairs.english: Tavi said no; he'd watched Master Yu check both sides recovered, while the clamp still gripped the pads.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说没有，他看着虞师傅确认两边恢复，夹子仍旧扣着垫木。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ shǒuzhǐ tíng zài nà méi luógǎn páng , shuō zhè dōngxī huà de tàixiǎo le , dàoxiàng zhǐshì gè zhuāngshì .
pairs.english: Mira rested a finger beside that screw, saying it was drawn too small and looked more like an ornament.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把手指停在那枚螺杆旁，说这东西画得太小了，倒像只是个装饰。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le yíhuìer , cóng tā nàlǐ jiè bǐ , bǎ luógǎn lìng huà zài kōng chù .
pairs.english: Tavi looked a while, borrowed her pen and drew the screw separately in an empty space.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了一会儿，从她那里借笔，把螺杆另画在空处。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ nàcì děng mǐlā nǐng wán zuìhòu bànquān shí , jiānbǎng bēng de fāsuān , shēngpà qiánmiàn de gōngfū quán báifèi .
pairs.english: He remembered waiting for Mira to finish the last half-turn that time, his shoulders aching with tension, afraid all the work beforehand would be wasted.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起自己那次等米拉拧完最后半圈时，肩膀绷得发酸，生怕前面的工夫全白费。

pairs.target: " wǒ nàshí zhǐ xiǎngzhe bié sōngshǒu . "
pairs.english: “All I thought then was: don't let go.”
pairs.hanzi: “我那时只想着别松手。”

pairs.target: mǐlā táitóu kàn tā .
pairs.english: Mira looked up at him.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉抬头看他。

pairs.target: " wǒ nàshí zhǐ xiǎngzhe nǐ bié cuī . "
pairs.english: “All I thought then was: you must not hurry me.”
pairs.hanzi: “我那时只想着你别催。”

pairs.target: yīwén zài pángbiān qīng ké , shuō liǎngwèi zǒngsuàn chéngrèn , nàge luógǎn búshì zìjǐ zhǎng jìnqù de .
pairs.english: Iven coughed softly beside them, saying the two had finally admitted that screw hadn't grown there by itself.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文在旁边轻咳，说两位总算承认，那个螺杆不是自己长进去的。

pairs.target: mǐlā méi ná zhǐ tuán dǎ tā , zhī wèn tǎ wéi míngrì hái liàn bu liàn .
pairs.english: Mira didn't throw a paper ball at him, only asked whether Tavi would practise again tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没拿纸团打他，只问塔维明日还练不练。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō xiǎng qù wèn wéi lǎoshī , zài shì yuánlái de nà tào , búyòng yú shīfu de tiěpiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi said he wanted to ask Instructor Vey and try their original set again, without using Master Yu's iron strips.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说想去问维老师，再试原来的那套，不用虞师傅的铁片。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō tā shàngwǔ yào qù jiāo jiù jiàn de tú , bùnéng zài tì tā nǐng .
pairs.english: Mira said she had to hand in the old-part drawing that morning and couldn't turn the screw for him again.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说她上午要去交旧件的图，不能再替他拧。

pairs.target: tā shuō búshì lái lā tā bāngmáng , zhǐ xiǎng wèn , nà zhāng huà zhe zhījià de tú kěbukěyǐ yìqǐ dàigěi lǎoshī kàn .
pairs.english: He said he hadn't come to ask her for help, only to ask whether he could bring along that drawing showing the support for the instructor to look at.
pairs.hanzi: 他说不是来拉她帮忙，只想问，那张画着支架的图可不可以一起带给老师看。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiǎng le xiǎng , bǎ tú cóng shū lǐ chōuchūlái , jiào tā kàn wán dài huílái , yòuxiàjiǎo de bǎng fǎ hái méi huà qīng .
pairs.english: Mira thought, pulled the diagram from her book, and told him to bring it back after showing it; the tying method in the lower right corner wasn't clear yet.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉想了想，把图从书里抽出来，叫他看完带回来，右下角的绑法还没画清。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò tú , méiyǒu bǎ tā gēn qúkǒu cǎogǎo dié zài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi took the drawing without stacking it together with the inlet draft.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过图，没有把它跟渠口草稿叠在一起。

pairs.target: tā lìng zhǎo yìzhāng zhǐdiàn zhe , lián biānjiǎo yě lǐ píng , fàngdào zìjǐ míngzǎo yào dài de shūshàng .
pairs.english: He found another sheet of paper as backing, even smoothed the corners, and laid it on the book he would take tomorrow morning.
pairs.hanzi: 他另找一张纸垫着，连边角也理平，放到自己明早要带的书上。

pairs.target: yīwén kànzhe tā , shuō zhè kē guǒzi zǒngsuàn méiyǒu bái suān .
pairs.english: Watching him, Iven said at least the fruit's sourness hadn't been wasted.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文看着他，说这颗果子总算没有白酸。
